qa_pairs.question: What test step is being performed for the control unit/simulation rear wheels?
qa_pairs.answer: Test Step 07 - Control unit/simulation rear wheels

qa_pairs.question: What voltage measurement is being tested in this step?
What should be done before testing the solenoid pressure build-up/drop/hold?
qa_pairs.answer: Turn on ignition, run engine, and check that battery is charged.

qa_pairs.question: What could cause high switching on power during this test?
qa_pairs.answer: Due to high switching on power, it may be necessary to repeat the test step with engine running.

qa_pairs.question: What should be replaced if test steps 08, 09 and 10 valves do not switch or pump does not run?
What are the job position codes referenced for this troubleshooting?
What phases can be checked in 325 iX cars and why?
qa_pairs.answer: Only the pressure building-up and pressure holding phases (2 A) can be checked in 325 iX cars because of the changed activation times in the control unit.

qa_pairs.question: Where will irregular values be displayed in 325 iX cars?
qa_pairs.answer: Irregular values will be displayed on adapter B in switch position (5 A).

qa_pairs.question: Why might it be necessary to repeat this test step?
qa_pairs.answer: It might be necessary to repeat this test step to reach the nominal values due to the high switching-on power and short switching phase.
